tools.name: tarx_health
tools.description: Check health status of all TARX services (inference, embeddings, mesh)
tools.returns: JSON with port status: inference (11435), embeddings (11437), mesh (11436)
tools.example_use: User asks 'is the system working?' or 'check health' -> call tarx_health

tools.name: tarx_chat
tools.description: Send a prompt to TARX - routes to Local (Qwen) or Network (Claude) based on intent

params.name: spaceId
params.description: Space ID for RAG context lookup

tools.returns: JSON with response, latency, route decision, model used, RAG chunks used
tools.example_use: Send a chat message with context -> call tarx_chat

tools.name: tarx_stress_test
tools.description: Run multiple chat requests to test TARX stability and performance
tools.returns: Summary stats: success rate, avg/min/max latency
tools.example_use: User asks 'test performance' or 'stress test' -> call tarx_stress_test

tools.name: tarx_list_spaces
tools.description: List all spaces in TARX app
tools.returns: Array of spaces with id, name, description, emoji
tools.example_use: User asks 'what projects do I have?' or 'list spaces' -> call tarx_list_spaces

tools.name: tarx_create_space
tools.description: Create a new space in TARX app
tools.example_use: User asks 'create a new project for X' -> call tarx_create_space

tools.name: tarx_get_space
tools.description: Get details of a specific space

params.name: spaceId
params.description: ID of the space to get

tools.example_use: User asks 'tell me about project X' -> call tarx_get_space

tools.name: tarx_list_sessions
tools.description: List all sessions/chats in a space
tools.returns: Array of sessions with id, title, message_count, updated_at
tools.example_use: User asks 'what conversations are in this project?' -> call tarx_list_sessions

tools.name: tarx_create_session
tools.description: Create a new session/chat in a space
tools.example_use: User asks 'start a new conversation in this project' -> call tarx_create_session

tools.name: tarx_get_chat_history
tools.description: Get full conversation history for a session

params.name: limit
params.description: Max number of messages to return

tools.returns: Array of messages with role, content, created_at
tools.example_use: User asks 'what did we discuss?' -> call tarx_get_chat_history

tools.name: tarx_send_message
tools.description: Send message to a specific session, get AI response, and store both in database
tools.returns: AI response, message IDs, latency, tokens used
tools.example_use: Continue conversation in a specific session -> call tarx_send_message

tools.name: tarx_memory_store
tools.description: Store information in TARX memory for future recall. Use this to save important context, decisions, preferences, or facts you want to remember.
tools.example_use: User says 'remember this' or 'save for later' -> call tarx_memory_store

tools.name: tarx_memory_search
tools.description: Search TARX memory for relevant information. Returns memories that match your query.
tools.returns: Array of matching memories with id, content, importance, accessCount
tools.example_use: User asks 'what do you know about X?' -> call tarx_memory_search

tools.name: tarx_memory_recall
tools.description: Recall relevant context from TARX memory based on the current topic. Use this at the start of conversations to load relevant history.

params.name: topic
params.description: The current topic to recall memories for

tools.returns: Formatted context with relevant memories and recent conversation
tools.example_use: Starting work on a topic -> call tarx_memory_recall to load context

tools.name: tarx_memory_list
tools.description: List all stored memories in TARX, optionally filtered by recency
tools.example_use: User asks 'what have you remembered?' -> call tarx_memory_list

tools.name: tarx_memory_delete
tools.description: Remove a specific memory from TARX storage

params.name: memoryId
params.description: The ID of the memory to forget

tools.example_use: User asks 'forget that' or 'delete memory X' -> call tarx_memory_delete

tools.name: tarx_memory_thread_to_session
tools.description: Thread a message to a specific TARX session. Use this to add messages to an existing conversation that will be persisted.
tools.example_use: Sync external conversation to TARX session -> call tarx_memory_thread_to_session

tools.name: tarx_list_files
tools.description: List files, optionally filtered by space

params.name: spaceId
params.description: Optional space ID to filter files

tools.returns: Array of files with id, filename, size_bytes
tools.example_use: User asks 'what files are in this project?' -> call tarx_list_files

tools.name: tarx_upload_file
tools.description: Upload a file to a space and automatically generate RAG embeddings

params.name: spaceId
params.description: ID of the space to upload to

tools.returns: File ID and embedding generation status
tools.example_use: User says 'add this document' -> call tarx_upload_file

tools.name: tarx_get_file
tools.description: Get the content of a file by ID

params.name: fileId
params.description: ID of the file to retrieve

tools.example_use: User asks 'show me file X' -> call tarx_get_file

tools.name: tarx_system_brief
tools.description: Get a comprehensive system status brief in a single call: inference, embeddings, mesh, database stats, memory stats, and any active errors
tools.returns: Complete system status with all services, stats, and errors
tools.example_use: User asks 'give me a full status' or 'system overview' -> call tarx_system_brief

tools.name: tarx_project_context
tools.description: Get full project context for a space in a single call: space details, sessions, recent messages, files, and knowledge stats

params.name: spaceId
params.description: ID of the space to get context for

tools.returns: Complete project context including sessions, files, recent messages, embedding count
tools.example_use: User asks 'what's in this project?' -> call tarx_project_context

tools.name: tarx_admin_status
tools.description: Get admin MCP server status and configuration
tools.example_use: User asks 'is the admin server running?' -> call tarx_admin_status

tools.name: tarx_admin_performance_metrics
tools.description: Get performance metrics for session orchestration
tools.returns: Metrics: task completion times, session counts, error rates
tools.example_use: User asks 'how is orchestration performing?' -> call tarx_admin_performance_metrics

tools.name: tarx_admin_file_lock
tools.description: Acquire a lock on a file to prevent conflicts between sessions
tools.example_use: Before editing a file that another session might touch -> call tarx_admin_file_lock

tools.name: tarx_admin_file_unlock
tools.description: Release a lock on a file
tools.example_use: Done editing a locked file -> call tarx_admin_file_unlock

tools.name: tarx_admin_file_conflicts
tools.description: Get all current file locks and identify potential conflicts
tools.returns: All active locks and potential conflicts
tools.example_use: User asks 'are there any file conflicts?' -> call tarx_admin_file_conflicts

tools.name: tarx_admin_start_code_session
tools.description: Start a Claude Code CLI session with a prompt. The session runs in the background.
tools.example_use: User wants to run Claude Code on a task -> call tarx_admin_start_code_session

tools.name: tarx_admin_list_code_sessions
tools.description: List all Claude Code sessions (running and completed)
tools.returns: Array of sessions with id, status, prompt, timestamps
tools.example_use: User asks 'what Claude Code sessions are running?' -> call tarx_admin_list_code_sessions

tools.name: tarx_admin_get_session_output
tools.description: Get the output from a Claude Code session
tools.example_use: User asks 'what did Claude Code output?' -> call tarx_admin_get_session_output

tools.name: tarx_admin_send_to_session
tools.description: Send a followup message to a running Claude Code session via stdin
tools.example_use: Send follow-up to running Claude Code -> call tarx_admin_send_to_session

tools.name: tarx_admin_stop_code_session
tools.description: Stop a running Claude Code session
tools.example_use: User asks 'stop that Claude Code session' -> call tarx_admin_stop_code_session

tools.name: tarx_admin_clear_code_sessions
tools.description: Clear completed/errored sessions from memory
tools.example_use: User asks 'clean up old sessions' -> call tarx_admin_clear_code_sessions

tools.name: tarx_dispatch_work
tools.description: Start a Claude Code session with TARX tethering. Creates a TARX session, orchestration entry, and auto-syncs output on completion.
tools.returns: CC session ID, TARX session ID, status
tools.example_use: User wants tracked work that persists -> call tarx_dispatch_work

tools.name: tarx_check_work
tools.description: Check status of tethered Claude Code work. If ccSessionId provided, returns detailed status.
tools.example_use: User asks 'how is that work going?' -> call tarx_check_work

tools.name: tarx_work_history
tools.description: Get persistent history of tethered Claude Code sessions. Survives restarts.
tools.example_use: User asks 'what work have I dispatched?' -> call tarx_work_history

tools.name: tarx_admin_read_console
tools.description: Read Workbench extension console logs. Returns recent [TARX] prefixed log lines.
tools.example_use: User asks 'show me recent logs' -> call tarx_admin_read_console

tools.name: tarx_admin_tail_console
tools.description: Get TARX console logs from the last N seconds. Useful for 'what just happened' debugging.
tools.example_use: User asks 'what just happened?' -> call tarx_admin_tail_console

tools.name: tarx_orchestrate_register_session
tools.description: Register a Claude Code session for orchestration
tools.example_use: Claude Code session starting up -> call tarx_orchestrate_register_session

tools.name: tarx_orchestrate_session_state
tools.description: Get current state of a session including current file, task, and thinking notes
tools.returns: Session state with current file, task, notes
tools.example_use: Check what a session is working on -> call tarx_orchestrate_session_state

tools.name: tarx_orchestrate_report_activity
tools.description: Report session activity (called by VS Code extension)
tools.example_use: Report that session did something -> call tarx_orchestrate_report_activity

tools.name: tarx_orchestrate_session_activity
tools.description: Get recent activity log for a session
tools.example_use: User asks 'what has this session been doing?' -> call tarx_orchestrate_session_activity

tools.name: tarx_orchestrate_list_sessions
tools.description: List all orchestrated sessions
tools.example_use: User asks 'what sessions are being orchestrated?' -> call tarx_orchestrate_list_sessions

tools.name: tarx_orchestrate_session_pause
tools.description: Pause or resume a session

params.name: paused
params.description: True to pause, false to resume

tools.example_use: User asks 'pause that session' -> call tarx_orchestrate_session_pause

tools.name: tarx_orchestrate_read_file
tools.description: Read a file from session workspace
tools.example_use: Read file in session context -> call tarx_orchestrate_read_file

tools.name: tarx_orchestrate_update_file
tools.description: Update a file in session workspace
tools.example_use: Update file in session context -> call tarx_orchestrate_update_file

tools.name: tarx_orchestrate_create_doc
tools.description: Create a documentation file
tools.example_use: Create documentation -> call tarx_orchestrate_create_doc

tools.name: tarx_orchestrate_list_docs
tools.description: List all managed documentation files
tools.example_use: User asks 'what docs exist?' -> call tarx_orchestrate_list_docs

tools.name: tarx_orchestrate_doc_history
tools.description: Get update history for a documentation file
tools.example_use: User asks 'what changes were made to this doc?' -> call tarx_orchestrate_doc_history

tools.name: tarx_orchestrate_assign_task
tools.description: Assign a task to a session
tools.example_use: Assign work to a session -> call tarx_orchestrate_assign_task

tools.name: tarx_orchestrate_task_update
tools.description: Update task status
tools.example_use: Mark task complete -> call tarx_orchestrate_task_update

tools.name: tarx_orchestrate_task_list
tools.description: List tasks with optional filters
tools.example_use: User asks 'what tasks are pending?' -> call tarx_orchestrate_task_list

tools.name: tarx_orchestrate_milestone_create
tools.description: Create a milestone for tracking progress
tools.example_use: Create a milestone for a release -> call tarx_orchestrate_milestone_create

tools.name: tarx_orchestrate_milestone_update
tools.description: Update milestone progress
tools.example_use: Update milestone progress -> call tarx_orchestrate_milestone_update

tools.name: tarx_orchestrate_milestone_list
tools.description: List all milestones
tools.example_use: User asks 'what milestones exist?' -> call tarx_orchestrate_milestone_list

tools.name: tarx_orchestrate_push_context
tools.description: Push context update to a session
tools.example_use: Push info to another session -> call tarx_orchestrate_push_context

tools.name: tarx_orchestrate_broadcast
tools.description: Broadcast message to all active sessions
tools.example_use: Announce something to all sessions -> call tarx_orchestrate_broadcast

tools.name: tarx_orchestrate_get_updates
tools.description: Get pending context updates for a session
tools.example_use: Check for updates from other sessions -> call tarx_orchestrate_get_updates

tools.name: tarx_orchestrate_mark_delivered
tools.description: Mark a context update as delivered
tools.example_use: Acknowledge receiving an update -> call tarx_orchestrate_mark_delivered

tools.name: tarx_orchestrate_request_feedback
tools.description: Request user feedback on a topic
tools.example_use: Ask user for input on a decision -> call tarx_orchestrate_request_feedback

tools.name: tarx_orchestrate_list_feedback_requests
tools.description: List all feedback requests
tools.example_use: Check what feedback is pending -> call tarx_orchestrate_list_feedback_requests

tools.name: tarx_orchestrate_status_report
tools.description: Generate comprehensive orchestration status report
tools.returns: Full status: sessions, tasks, milestones, activity
tools.example_use: User asks 'give me an orchestration overview' -> call tarx_orchestrate_status_report

tools.name: tarx_daemon_start
tools.description: Start the autonomous daemon. Watches orch_tasks for pending items, spawns Claude Code sessions, updates status. Safety: max 2 concurrent, 5min timeout, 3 retries.
tools.example_use: User asks 'start the daemon' -> call tarx_daemon_start

tools.name: tarx_daemon_stop
tools.description: Stop the autonomous daemon. Active sessions are terminated.
tools.example_use: User asks 'stop the daemon' -> call tarx_daemon_stop

tools.name: tarx_daemon_status
tools.description: Get daemon status: running state, task stats, active sessions, safety counters.
tools.example_use: User asks 'is the daemon running?' -> call tarx_daemon_status
